counter.clock: CR.CT=0 selects PCLK; MSCR.SMS=0 selects internal clock
counter.period_formula: (ARR+1)*prescaler/PCLK; derived from own-manual count sequence 0..ARR then 0
counter.basic_counter_min: No explicit nonzero minimum ARR in register table. SDK says 0..65535. Conservative HAL min=2 ticks is permissible but policy, not a universal documented hardware minimum.

pwm.CH4: Internal compare-only; explicitly no external pin and cannot capture. Not external PWM channel4.
pwm.configuration: CR.MODE=2, DIR=0, CT=0, COMP=0, PWM2S=1; MSCR.SMS=0; CHxCR.CSA=0; DTR.MOE=1, DTEN=0; FLTR.OCMxAFLTxA=6 and CCPxA=0
pwm.PWM1: Up-count single-point: high while CNT<CCRxA, low otherwise
pwm.PWM2: Up-count single-point: low while CNT<CCRxA, high otherwise
pwm.minimum: Initial CNT must be < ARR. For initial CNT0, ARR>=1 and period>=2 ticks.
pwm.maximum: Hardware period65536 (ARR65535) cannot represent CCR=65536 for conventional 100% duty. Bound ordinary PWM period<=65535 or deliberately implement forced-output endpoints.
pwm.MOE: DTR.MOE[12] global output-compare enable. No per-channel output enable for CH1..3. MOE=0 electrical level is not specified; do not promise driven-low or use global MOE for single-channel disable.
pwm.inactive: OCMxAFLTxA=0 forces low at normal polarity; mode1+CCR0 is mathematically always low. For strictly evidenced inactive state, normal polarity + forced low is documented.
pwm.forced_endpoints: OCMxAFLTxA=0 force low;1 force high; these do not stop counter/compare events.
pwm.brake: CHxCR.BKSA[1:0]/BKSB[3:2]:0 high impedance,1 unaffected,2 forced low,3 forced high during braking; not normal output-enable bits. Keep BKE/AOE/SAFEEN/VCE/deadtime/complementary out of bounded mode.

preload_update.ARR: CR.BUFPEN[7]=0 immediate;1 update-event transfer. ARR cache updates immediately when counter disabled or cache disabled.
preload_update.UG: CR.UG[25]=1 self-clears; initializes counter, transfers enabled ARR/CCR buffers, clears prescaler counter without changing PRS.
preload_update.URS: CR.URS[17]=0:overflow/underflow/software UG/slave reset;1:overflow/underflow only. For guaranteed software initialization use URS0 then UG and clear flags; do not assume UG emits UEV while URS1.
preload_update.RCR: RCR[7:0] yields update after RCR+1 relevant overflows; masks OV[8]/UD[9].

interrupts.ICR: R1W0 at0x14; write0 clears requested bit, write1 preserves. SDK writes ~mask.
interrupts.UIF_vs_OVF: Distinct update-event flag versus every-wrap overflow flag; RCR and URS affect update events.

clock_reset.enable: SYSCTRL.APBEN2[7], offset0x34;1 enables configuration and working clock
clock_reset.independence: One ATIM per family; ATIM gate/reset separate from BTIM/GTIM, but all ATIM channels share the same ATIM gate/reset.

differences_and_conflicts.fact: No DMA fields: CHxCR[11:10] reserved, CH4CR.CDE absent, MSCR[4:3] reserved. Existing cw32f003_v1 correctly omits these. Bounded mode uses same remaining fields.
Own manual MSCR bit4 reserved (p329); SVD-derived cw32l052_v1 exposes MSM bit4. Keep zero. PAC removal or correction should be documented as a manual/SVD conflict, not treated as proven capability.
Own shared timer pin table p264 lists CH2A PA05, conflicting with established datasheet PA04. Use package datasheet route evidence, not timer-table typo.
Update-event narrative calls clearing field ATIM_ICR.UIE; ICR register table names correct UIF bit0. Use UIF.

excluded_family.reason: Own current datasheet p16 enumerates four GTIM and three BTIM; no ATIM. Own whole manual contains no ATIM token.

datasheet.marker: CW32F020 微控制器内部集成多达四个通用定时器，以及三个基本定时器。

counter.divisors: hardware PSC+1; HAL exposes powers of two 1..32768

pwm.modes: 4 forced low;5 forced high;6 PWM1 high CNT<CCR;7 PWM2 low CNT<CCR
pwm.preload: CR1.ARPE=1;OCyPE=1;PSC always buffered;UG loads shadows and resets CNT/prescaler;RCR=0 updates every overflow
pwm.enable: CCER=0x1111 and BDTR.MOE=1 after forced-inactive setup;CCPC=0 immediate mode changes;NE/NP and CH5/6 kept zero
pwm.shutdown: force inactive,stop,disconnect pads,then clear CCER/MOE;no electrical claim when MOE=0

flags.overflow: UIF bit0 with RCR0;all other events preserved by clear

hal_policy.actual_clock: RCC operating conditions qualify PCLK;ATIM selection uses PCLK ClockBounds.maximum(), getters separately report nominal frequency and bounds
hal_policy.classic_minimum_period: two ticks conservatively for both polling and PWM;not asserted hardware counter minimum
hal_policy.classic_software_update: temporarily URS0 for UG to resolve narrative ambiguity;IRQs/DMA are disabled;restore URS1 then clear pending update at construction/reconfiguration
hal_policy.shared_ownership: one Peri ATIM owns all channels and independent gate/reset;no sibling BTIM/GTIM gate mutation
